name: aio-arr
description: One login and one page for your whole *arr stack: Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, Komga, Kavita and your download clients

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
